# Toast (L1 primitive)

Transient notification. Mount `<Toaster />` once at the app root (Host does not mount it). Then call `toast.add({ title, description?, type?, timeout? })` — not `toast()` as a function.

**when** Confirm/save feedback. Put `<Toaster position="bottom-right" timeout={4000} limit={3} />` in the root, then `toast.add(...)`.
